messages:
maria: Quick sync — I have three linked PRs that need a short approval chain before we can promote to staging: sdk-client#482, runtime-serving#701, helm-charts#134. Blocking items: @ryan approval on runtime changes, @anita helm values sanity check. Can folks PTAL? Need staging by EOD Friday.
ryan: On it, pulling runtime-serving#701 now. Any breaking API surface?
maria: No API changes. Mostly KV cache gating + kernel selector tweak. Runtime unit tests pass locally.
anita: I can take helm-charts#134 tonight. Any special values to watch?
maria: Yes — we added `enablePrefixCache: true` and bumped `replicaCount` for canary to 2. See snippet: ```yaml
canary:
  replicaCount: 2
  helmOverrides:
    runtime.kvCache.enabled: true
```
leo: FYI, I saw a flake in perf tests for runtime-serving on long-seq workloads earlier — failing at 95th p99 latency check. Not sure if related.
maria: Thanks @leo — that might be from the kernel selector change. I've got a small fallback in the PR to force previous kernel on sequences > 8 during canary.
ryan: Reviewing now. If tests are green and canary has fallback we can merge and schedule a staged rollout.
ci-bot: sdk-client#482 — CI: passed ✅
ci-bot: runtime-serving#701 — CI: flaky tests detected (2/10) ❗ — see logs: https://ci.example/rt-701
ci-bot: helm-charts#134 — CI: passed ✅
anita: I'll validate helm templates with `helm template --values canary.yaml` and check we don't accidentally expose ports.
maria: Appreciate it. If helm looks good, can we merge sdk-client and helm first, then runtime with a canary window? Order matters because sdk-client changes call new runtime endpoints.
ryan: Agreed. Merge order sdk-client -> helm -> runtime. I'll queue runtime canary with `deploy-bot canary runtime-serving#701 --window 30m` after others land.
deploy-bot: Received request. Will await PR merges and then run canary as instructed.
leo: Once runtime canary starts, I'll run the perf harness against staging for 30m and report p50/p95/p99.
maria: Thanks. If p99 exceeds baseline by >10% revert policy kicks in (auto rollback). Also adding a small smoke test to the canary job.
ryan: Quick heads-up — I might be delayed by an oncall page around 15:30 PDT. If I don't respond, merge sdk-client/helm and I'll pick up runtime when available.
anita: I can also approve runtime helm values if you get pulled away.
maria: Perfect. I'll post final merge checklist here once CI stabilizes. :thumbsup:
ryan: LGTM (prelim). Will finish review in ~20m. :eyes:
ci-bot: runtime-serving#701 — CI: passed on retry ✅
ryan: Approved and merged runtime-serving#701 (merged by ryan).
ci-bot: sdk-client#482 — merged ✅
ci-bot: helm-charts#134 — merged ✅
deploy-bot: Starting canary: runtime-serving v1.7.3-canary (window 30m). Monitoring hooks enabled.
leo: Kicked off perf tests against canary now. Will report in 15m.
maria: Thanks team — I'll update the release notes and the ticket. If any rollback needed ping here. :rocket:
